tools.title: AI Summarizer
tools.summary: Get a short, faithful summary of a PDF, written as you watch.

ui.notice: AI tools use Claude by Anthropic: the text extracted from your PDF is sent to Anthropic's API to produce the result. Images and the file itself are not sent.

tools.title: Translate PDF
tools.summary: Translate a PDF into another language and keep its layout, images and tables.

ui.notice: AI tools use Claude by Anthropic: the text extracted from your PDF is sent to Anthropic's API to produce the result. Images and the file itself are not sent.

tools.title: JPG to PDF
tools.summary: Put photos and images into a PDF — page size, orientation and margins as you like.

tools.title: PDF to JPG
tools.summary: Turn each page into a JPG or PNG, or pull out the images inside the PDF.

tools.title: PDF to Word
tools.summary: An editable DOCX that keeps paragraphs, tables and images where it can.

mode.description: Layout keeps positions, tables and images; Text rebuilds plain paragraphs (best for scanned PDFs that were OCR'd)
mode.title: Mode

tools.title: PDF to Excel
tools.summary: Find the tables in a PDF and put them into a spreadsheet.

strategy.description: Lines finds ruled tables; Text finds tables aligned by whitespace
strategy.title: Strategy

tools.title: PDF to Markdown
tools.summary: Clean Markdown with headings, lists, tables and links — handy for notes and AI tools.

images.description: Mark where images were, or leave them out
images.title: Images

headers_footers.description: Running headers, footers and page numbers
headers_footers.title: Headers Footers

page_breaks.description: Mark page breaks with a rule
page_breaks.title: Page Breaks

tools.title: Compress PDF
tools.summary: Make a PDF smaller while keeping it readable — choose how hard to squeeze the images.

labels.extreme: Extreme — smallest file, lower image quality (72 dpi)
labels.less: Less — high quality, less compression (220 dpi)
labels.recommended: Recommended — good quality, good compression (150 dpi)

tools.title: Repair PDF
tools.summary: Rebuild a damaged PDF that won't open, and recover as much of it as possible.

tools.title: OCR PDF
tools.summary: Turn a scanned PDF into one you can search, select and copy text from.

languages.description: Up to three languages that appear in the document
languages.title: Document languages

tools.title: PDF to PDF/A
tools.summary: Convert a PDF to PDF/A for long-term archiving (levels 1b, 2b, 3b).

tools.title: Office to PDF
tools.summary: Convert Word, PowerPoint and Excel files (or their OpenDocument cousins) to PDF.

one_page_per_sheet.title: Spreadsheets: each sheet on one page

tools.title: PDF to PowerPoint
tools.summary: Turn PDF pages into editable PowerPoint slides.

tools.title: Rotate PDF
tools.summary: Turn pages the right way up — all of them, some, or only portrait or landscape ones.

only.description: Rotate only portrait or only landscape pages
only.title: Only

tools.title: Add page numbers
tools.summary: Number pages in any corner, with your own format, font and starting number.

tools.title: Add watermark
tools.summary: Stamp text or an image over (or under) your pages, once or as a tiled pattern.

image_id.description: An image uploaded with this job
image_id.title: Image Id

image_scale.description: Image width as a share of the page width
image_scale.title: Image Scale

tools.title: Crop PDF
tools.summary: Trim margins or cut pages down to the area you draw.

FracRect.description: A box on the visible page, as fractions of its width/height (origin top-left).
FracRect.title: FracRect

remove_outside.description: Also delete the content outside the box (a crop alone only hides it)
remove_outside.title: Remove Outside

tools.title: Edit PDF
tools.summary: Add text, images, shapes, highlights, white-out and drawings to any page.

tools.title: PDF forms
tools.summary: Fill in a form, add fields to a flat PDF (or let heypdf find the blanks) and flatten it.

value.description: Default text, or the on-value of a radio button
value.title: Value

detect.description: Create fields automatically where the page has blanks, lines and boxes
detect.title: Detect

flatten.description: Make the filled form permanent (no longer editable)
flatten.title: Flatten

tools.title: Merge PDF
tools.summary: Combine several PDFs into one, in the order you set.

bookmarks.description: Keep each file's bookmarks, add one bookmark per file, or drop them
bookmarks.title: Bookmarks

tools.title: Split PDF
tools.summary: Cut a PDF into parts: by page ranges, every N pages, every page or by file size.

merge.description: Merge all ranges into one PDF
merge.title: Merge

tools.title: Remove pages
tools.summary: Delete the pages you don't need.

tools.title: Extract pages
tools.summary: Take pages out of a PDF, as separate files or together in one.

pages.description: Pages to extract, e.g. 1, 3-5 (all = every page)
pages.title: Pages

merge.description: Put the extracted pages into one PDF
merge.title: Merge

tools.title: Organize PDF
tools.summary: Reorder, rotate, delete and insert pages — also pages from other PDFs and blank pages.

file.description: Index of the source file in file_ids
file.title: File

pages.description: The new document, page by page; leave empty to keep every page in order
pages.title: Pages

tools.title: Scan to PDF
tools.summary: Turn photos of paper into a clean, straightened PDF — or send them from your phone.

corners.description: Per image (in file order): 4 corner points as image fractions, or null
corners.title: Corners

tools.title: Unlock PDF
tools.summary: Remove the password and restrictions from a PDF you have the password for.

password.description: Only needed if the file asks for one to open
password.title: Password

tools.title: Protect PDF
tools.summary: Encrypt a PDF with a password (AES-256) and limit printing, copying or editing.

owner_password.description: Needed to change permissions (random if empty)
owner_password.title: Owner Password

tools.title: Sign PDF
tools.summary: Type, draw or upload your signature and place it — optionally with a digital (PAdES) signature from your own certificate.

pages.description: Where to place it: 1, last, all, 1-3 …
pages.title: Pages

pages.description: Where to place it: 1, last, all, 1-3 …
pages.title: Pages

text.description: Name, initials, a note … {date} is replaced by today's date
text.title: Text

style.description: How the visible signature is made; none = digital signature only
style.title: Style

text.description: Your name as it should appear
text.title: Text

utc_offset_min.description: The signer's UTC offset in minutes, so {date} is their local date (sent by the editor)
utc_offset_min.title: Utc Offset Min

digital.description: Also add a cryptographic (PAdES) signature with your own .p12/.pfx certificate
digital.title: Digital

tools.title: Redact PDF
tools.summary: Permanently remove text, numbers and areas — really gone, not just covered up.

label.description: Text shown on each box, e.g. REDACTED
label.title: Label

images.description: Blank the covered pixels, or remove touched images entirely
images.title: Images

graphics.description: Vector graphics under a drawn box: remove only those it fully covers, or every one it touches — which also removes page backgrounds, table fills, banners and borders that reach into the box (text on them may become invisible)
graphics.title: Graphics

sanitize.description: Also remove metadata, attachments, scripts and thumbnails
sanitize.title: Sanitize

remove_hidden_text.description: Remove invisible text (e.g. an OCR layer) everywhere
remove_hidden_text.title: Remove Hidden Text

tools.title: Compare PDF
tools.summary: See what changed between two versions: word by word, or as a visual overlay.

page_a.description: Overlay: page of the first file (all if empty)
page_a.title: Page A

sensitivity.description: Overlay: pixel difference treated as a change
sensitivity.title: Sensitivity

tools.title: HTML to PDF
tools.summary: Save a web page — or an HTML file — as a PDF, as one long page or split into printable pages.

url.description: Leave empty to capture an uploaded HTML file instead
url.title: Web page address

single_page.description: Keep the page as one continuous sheet, as it looks on screen
single_page.title: One long page
